{{Quote|Good monster! Good, good monster! Daddy loves you. Now, go back in the nice warm water.|Phelon|<ref name="Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld">''[[Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld]]''</ref>}}
'''Hobbrock''' was a [[giant walking fish]] that lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. It was the pet [[Fish/Legends|fish]] of [[Phelon]], a criminal mastermind hiding in an ancient [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on the shore of what locals referred to as the burning [[Water/Legends|water]]. The fish swam in the boiling, [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]] water, defending against intruders. Hobbrock readily responded to the commands of its master, and it loved to eat [[glowworm]]s.
